gloss: to prepare; to arrange; to have ready

definitions.gloss: to prepare; to arrange; to have ready
definitions.explanation: To make specific items or arrangements ready for use, often implying that the items will be needed soon or are being laid out for someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ごはん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{用意|ようい}する。
お⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧さま⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧しました。
examples.english: I prepared chairs for the guests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{万|まん}が{一|いち}→万が一：17693_mangaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{予備|よび}→予備：03993_yobi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧しておいて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please have a spare battery ready just in case.

notes:
Focuses on having specific items or arrangements ready and at hand. More concrete and action-oriented than ⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧, which covers broader preparation processes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{用意|ようい}する: to prepare a meal
- {お{金|かね}を{用意|ようい}する: to have money ready
- {席|せき}を{用意|ようい}する: to prepare a seat
- {用意|ようい}ができた: it's ready
- {用意|ようい}ドン: ready, set, go!
- {用意|ようい}{周到|しゅうとう}: thoroughly prepared

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {準備|じゅんび}する: to prepare — broader and more process-oriented; covers planning and organizing
- {支度|したく}する: to get ready — personal preparation (getting dressed, packing)
- {整|ととの}える: to arrange / to put in order — emphasizes organizing and tidying

USAGE:
The set phrase {用意|ようい}ドン is used to start races and games, equivalent to "ready, set, go!" The compound {用意|ようい}{周到|しゅうとう} (thorough preparation) is a common four-character idiom praising someone's careful planning.
